haiku-low.q1: It returns 202 with a list of rejected events (batch index, event_id, reason). It does so only after every accepted event is written to the log with full-replica acknowledgement.
haiku-low.q2: It resends the whole batch. Events already written become duplicates, which dedup drops later.
haiku-low.q3: The first copy received wins. Later copies are dropped from the clean path and kept only in the raw archive.
haiku-low.q4: Tuesday. received_at alone decides the day, so it belongs to Tuesday's partition and replay. The client timestamp is never used.
haiku-low.q5: In the existing key-value store. Each event_id key holds (partition, offset) with an 8-day TTL, and expiry removes old entries.
haiku-low.q6: Dedup stops and retries, committing nothing. What the collector does with clients' continued sends is NOT STATED.
haiku-low.q7: Offsets are committed only after the load succeeds, so nothing is lost. The load is idempotent (merge on event_id or batch id), so retries do not double-count.
haiku-low.q8: It reads only the raw archive in object storage, for days D-8 through D. Rebuilt rows go to a staging table, which is then atomically swapped into partition D.
haiku-low.q9: For each event_id it takes the copy with the lowest (partition, offset) from raw days D-8 to D. It keeps that copy only if its received_at falls in day D.
haiku-low.q10: The atomic replace leaves the old partition in place, so dashboards see no mix. The operator re-runs the replay, and staging is discarded or fixed.
haiku-low.q11: Only closed days: past 02:00 UTC on D+1, archive watermark past end of D, raw D-8 to D still present, and no other replay of D running. That is about 82 days.
haiku-low.q12: NOT STATED as decided. Product has not chosen drop or keep-with-flag, and until it does the bot step does nothing.

sonnet.q1: Only after every accepted event is written to the log with full-replica acknowledgement does it return 202, listing the rejected events (batch index, event_id if present, reason). Malformed events are rejected individually; the rest are accepted. It returns 202 even if all are rejected.
sonnet.q2: The client resends the whole batch. Events already written become duplicates and are dropped later.
sonnet.q3: The first copy received (lowest partition/offset for the same event_id) wins and reaches the warehouse; the later copy is dropped from the clean path but stays in the raw archive.
sonnet.q4: Tuesday. received_at (00:10 UTC Tuesday) alone decides day, partition and replay; the client timestamp is never used.
sonnet.q5: In the key-value store (KV). Each event_id key is set if not exists with value (partition, offset). Entries are removed by an 8-day per-key TTL.
sonnet.q6: Dedup stops and retries; it does not commit offsets and does not guess. The document does not say anything about client-facing effects beyond that; the collector keeps writing events to the log, which retains them 14 days.
sonnet.q7: The load is idempotent (merge on event_id or load under a batch id) and log offsets are committed only after the load succeeds. On redelivery the retry is safe, so no loss and no double-count. Dedup also treats a key holding its own (partition, offset) as the winner.
sonnet.q8: It reads only the raw archive (days D-8 through D), never the log or live KV. Rebuilt events are written to a staging table that dashboards never read.
sonnet.q9: It reads (event_id, partition, offset, received_at) for raw days D-8 through D. For each event_id the winner is the copy with the lowest (partition, offset). It keeps a winner only if its received_at is in day D, so events first received earlier are not in D.
sonnet.q10: The swap is not done (validation failure) or the atomic replace fails, leaving the old partition in place; dashboards keep the old day. The operator discards or fixes staging and re-runs the replay.
sonnet.q11: Closed days only: now is past 02:00 UTC on D+1, the archiver watermark has passed the end of D on every partition, raw data for D-8 through D still exists (limiting replay to within about 82 days), and no other replay of D is running.
sonnet.q12: Undecided. Product has not decided whether to drop or keep with a flag. Until decided, the bot step in enrichment does nothing. The raw archive keeps everything either way.
